Laura — thanks for the note and the attendee list. Quick heads up: Soojin (SE) is scheduled to travel that afternoon and has a pre-existing exec enablement call that conflicts with our 1:00 PM PT slot. I put together a couple of options so we can keep momentum without losing depth: 

Options (ranked by least disruption):
1) Split the session: 30m focused walkthrough at 1:00 PM PT (Rafael + Connor to lead overview + live demo), then a separate 30m deep-dive Q&A/architecture session with Soojin next week when he's back. We can record the walkthrough and Soojin will join the live Q&A.
2) Keep Sep 22 but move start to 12:15 PM PT so Soojin can join until ~12:50 PM PT, then we finish without him. I realize this may be tight for your execs.
3) Swap coverage: Connor covers the full session at 1:00 PM PT (he's briefed), and Soojin runs a follow-up technical clinic for any SSO/data questions the following week.

I'm attaching the latest deck and a proposed itinerary (ICS) for the split option — it would let us honor your 1:00 PM preference for a concise walkthrough and then schedule the technical deep-dive. If splitting, we'll mark the recording explicitly and label the follow-up as "Soojins deep-dive: GlacierPay architecture."

Let me know which approach you prefer. If helpful, Marissa can own scheduling and coordinate invite updates.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com
